title: Hail the Day That Sees Him Rise
description: Hail the Day That Sees Him Rise in Tonic Solfa to LLANFAIR: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the six verses, and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley’s Ascension hymn was published in 1739. The tune LLANFAIR is by Robert Williams (1817).
underlay: Hail the day that sees Him_ rise, Al__-le_-lu-ia! To His Throne a-bove_ the skies; Al__-le_-lu-ia! Christ, the Lamb for sin_-ners_ given, Al__-le-lu-ia! En-ters now the high-est_ heaven. Al__-le_-lu-ia!

lines: Hail the day that sees Him rise
To His Throne above the skies;
Christ, the Lamb for sinners given,
There for Him high triumph waits;
He hath conquered death and sin;
Take the King of glory in.
Lo! the heaven its Lord receives,
Yet He loves the earth He leaves;
Still He calls mankind His own.
See! He lifts His Hands above;
See! He shews the prints of love;
He the first-fruits of our race.
Lord, though parted from our sight
Grant our hearts may thither rise,
